newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch NAM says discovered sizeable gas reserves.
newsitem.headline: Dutch NAM says discovered sizeable gas reserves.

text.p: Dutch oil and gas exploration company Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) said on Thursday it had discovered promising gas reserves in the northern Dutch province of Friesland.
"The reserves are estimated at eight billion cubic metres (bcm). We don't know for sure when production will start, but maybe at around the turn of the century," a company spokesman said.
He added the gas was of a higher calorific value than the average Dutch grade.
NAM is jointly owned by Royal Dutch/Shell and Exxon Group.
In 1996, natural gas production in the Netherlands totalled 89.6 bcm.
